name: n6_power
title: STM32N6 power

layout.rules: tps62130 11.1: "the direct common ground connection of AGND and PGND to the exposed thermal pad and the system ground (ground plane) is mandatory"; "connect the VOS pin in the shortest way to VOUT at the output capacitor"; "The capacitor on the SS/TR pin and on AVIN as well as the FB resistors ... should be kept close to the IC". lp5907: 1 µF at IN and OUT.

open_questions: Power-up order: ST's rule (an5967 3.5.1) is met by two LDOs of one family starting together (as the Nucleo); not measured. LP5907's minimum turn-on time is not given: ds Table 26 lists a 20 µs/V minimum ramp for VDDA18AON (80 µs typical for 1.8 V is 44 µs/V).
Power-down: both always-on LDOs fall with the 5 V; the 1.8 V must not exceed VDD by 50 mV on the way down (an5967 3.5.2): VDD carries more capacitance, so it should fall last; not checked.
LP5907's 5.5 V maximum input on a 5 V bus: the bus input block must clamp over-voltage (the HAT's TPS2121 has OV disabled).
Camera current unknown (Raspberry Pi publishes none); TPS62132 sized at 3 A.
